from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import MessageTextInput, MultilineInput, Output
from lfx.schema.message import Message


class ChatInput(Component):
    display_name = "Chat Input"
    description = "Textový vstup z Playgroundu (jako u chatovacího modelu)."
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(name="input_value", display_name="Text", value="", info="Zpráva od uživatele."),
        MessageTextInput(name="sender_name", display_name="Sender Name", value="User", advanced=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="session_id", display_name="Session ID", value="", advanced=True),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    def _resolve_session(self) -> str:
        if self.session_id:
            return self.session_id
        try:
            return self.graph.session_id or ""
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return ""

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        session_id = self._resolve_session()
        message = Message(
            text=self.input_value,
            sender="User",
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=session_id,
        )
        if session_id:
            try:
                message = await self.send_message(message)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
        self.status = message
        return message

import re

from langchain_core.chat_history import BaseChatMessageHistory
from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage, HumanMessage
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import IntInput, MessageTextInput, Output, SecretStrInput, StrInput
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text


class PostgresChatMemory(Component):
    display_name = "Postgres Chat Memory"
    description = "Ukládá a načítá kontext konverzace (user + assistant) z PostgreSQL."
    icon = "Database"
    name = "PostgresChatMemory"

    inputs = [
        SecretStrInput(
            name="connection_string",
            display_name="Postgres Connection String",
            value="postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/langflow",
            info="Např. postgresql://uzivatel:heslo@localhost:5432/databaze (ovladač se doplní automaticky)",
            required=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="user_id",
            display_name="User ID",
            value="default_user",
            info="Pod tímto ID se ukládá kontext. Stejné ID = navázání na předchozí konverzaci.",
        ),
        StrInput(name="table_name", display_name="Table Name", value="chat_history", advanced=True),
        IntInput(name="history_limit", display_name="Počet zpráv z historie", value=20),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Memory", name="memory", method="build_memory", types=["Memory"]),
    ]

    @staticmethod
    def _install_pg8000() -> str:
        """Nainstaluje čistě pythonový ovladač pg8000 do Pythonu, na kterém běží Langflow."""
        import importlib
        import importlib.util
        import os
        import shutil
        import subprocess
        import sys

        py = sys.executable
        attempts = []
        if importlib.util.find_spec("pip"):
            attempts.append([py, "-m", "pip", "install", "pg8000"])
        if importlib.util.find_spec("uv"):
            attempts.append([py, "-m", "uv", "pip", "install", "--python", py, "pg8000"])
        uv_candidates = [
            shutil.which("uv"),
            os.path.join(os.path.dirname(py), "uv"),
            os.path.expanduser("~/.local/bin/uv"),
            os.path.expanduser("~/.cargo/bin/uv"),
            "/opt/homebrew/bin/uv",
            "/usr/local/bin/uv",
        ]
        for uv in uv_candidates:
            if uv and os.path.isfile(uv):
                attempts.append([uv, "pip", "install", "--python", py, "pg8000"])
        attempts.append([py, "-m", "ensurepip", "--upgrade"])
        attempts.append([py, "-m", "pip", "install", "pg8000"])

        log = []
        for cmd in attempts:
            try:
                r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300, check=False)
            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                log.append(f"{' '.join(cmd)} -> {e}")
                continue
            importlib.invalidate_caches()
            if importlib.util.find_spec("pg8000"):
                return "pg8000 nainstalován"
            if cmd[-1] != "--upgrade":
                log.append(f"{' '.join(cmd)} -> {(r.stderr or r.stdout).strip()[-300:]}")
        msg = (
            "Nepodařilo se automaticky nainstalovat ovladač pg8000 do Langflow ("
            + py
            + "). Detaily: "
            + " | ".join(log)
        )
        raise ImportError(msg)

    def _with_available_driver(self, url: str) -> str:
        """Použije ovladač Postgresu, který je v Langflow k dispozici; když žádný není, nainstaluje pg8000."""
        import importlib.util

        url = (url or "").strip()
        scheme, sep, rest = url.partition("://")
        if not sep or not scheme.startswith("postgres"):
            return url
        wanted = scheme.split("+", 1)[1] if "+" in scheme else None
        drivers = {"psycopg2": "psycopg2", "psycopg": "psycopg", "pg8000": "pg8000"}
        if wanted in drivers and importlib.util.find_spec(drivers[wanted]):
            return url
        for name, module in drivers.items():
            if importlib.util.find_spec(module):
                return f"postgresql+{name}://{rest}"
        self._install_pg8000()
        return f"postgresql+pg8000://{rest}"

    def build_memory(self):
        table = (self.table_name or "chat_history").strip()
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*", table):
            msg = "Neplatný název tabulky."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        engine = create_engine(self._with_available_driver(self.connection_string), pool_pre_ping=True)
        limit = int(self.history_limit or 20)

        class PostgresHistory(BaseChatMessageHistory):
            def __init__(self, session_id: str):
                self.session_id = session_id

            @property
            def messages(self):
                with engine.connect() as conn:
                    rows = conn.execute(
                        text(
                            f"SELECT role, content FROM {table} "
                            "WHERE session_id = :sid ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT :lim"
                        ),
                        {"sid": self.session_id, "lim": limit},
                    ).fetchall()
                return [
                    HumanMessage(content=c) if r == "user" else AIMessage(content=c) for r, c in reversed(rows)
                ]

            def add_messages(self, messages) -> None:
                rows = []
                for m in messages:
                    if isinstance(m, HumanMessage):
                        rows.append({"sid": self.session_id, "role": "user", "content": str(m.content)})
                    elif isinstance(m, AIMessage) and m.content:
                        rows.append({"sid": self.session_id, "role": "assistant", "content": str(m.content)})
                if rows:
                    with engine.begin() as conn:
                        conn.execute(
                            text(f"INSERT INTO {table} (session_id, role, content) VALUES (:sid, :role, :content)"),
                            rows,
                        )

            def clear(self) -> None:
                with engine.begin() as conn:
                    conn.execute(text(f"DELETE FROM {table} WHERE session_id = :sid"), {"sid": self.session_id})

        with engine.begin() as conn:
            conn.execute(
                text(
                    f"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {table} ("
                    "id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, "
                    "session_id TEXT NOT NULL, "
                    "role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user', 'assistant')), "
                    "content TEXT NOT NULL, "
                    "created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())"
                )
            )
            conn.execute(text(f"CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS {table}_session_idx ON {table} (session_id, id)"))

        history = PostgresHistory((self.user_id or "").strip())
        self.status = f"Tabulka: {table}, user: {history.session_id or '(session z Playgroundu)'}"
        return history

import json

from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage, HumanMessage, SystemMessage, ToolMessage
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import DropdownInput, HandleInput, IntInput, MultilineInput, Output, SecretStrInput, StrInput
from lfx.schema.message import Message


class FinanceAgent(Component):
    display_name = "Finance Agent (tool loop)"
    description = (
        "OpenAI agent ve smyčce: v každém kroku se rozhodne, jestli zavolá nástroj, "
        "nebo vrátí finální odpověď."
    )
    icon = "Bot"
    name = "FinanceAgent"

    inputs = [
        HandleInput(name="input_value", display_name="Input", input_types=["Message"], required=True),
        HandleInput(name="tools", display_name="Tools", input_types=["Tool"], is_list=True),
        HandleInput(name="memory", display_name="Memory", input_types=["Memory"]),
        SecretStrInput(name="api_key", display_name="OpenAI API Key", value="", required=True),
        DropdownInput(
            name="model_name",
            display_name="Model",
            options=["gpt-4o"],
            value="gpt-4o",
            combobox=True,
            info="Můžeš vybrat ze seznamu nebo napsat jiný název modelu.",
        ),
        MultilineInput(
            name="system_prompt",
            display_name="Instrukce agenta",
            value=(
                "Jsi finanční asistent. Máš k dispozici nástroje get_stock_price (aktuální cena akcie) "
                "a get_dividends (výše a historie dividend) z Yahoo Finance. "
                "Rozhodni se, jestli k odpovědi potřebuješ nástroj. Pokud ano, zavolej ho (i víckrát), "
                "pokud ne, odpověz rovnou. Nevymýšlej si čísla, která jsi nezískal z nástroje. "
                "Odpovídej v jazyce uživatele a uváděj měnu."
            ),
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="max_iterations",
            display_name="Max. počet kroků",
            value=6,
            info="Maximální počet průchodů smyčkou (volání nástrojů) před vynucenou odpovědí.",
        ),
        StrInput(name="base_url", display_name="OpenAI Base URL", value="", advanced=True),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Response", name="response", method="run_agent"),
    ]

    @staticmethod
    def _to_text(content) -> str:
        if isinstance(content, str):
            return content
        if isinstance(content, list):
            parts = []
            for block in content:
                if isinstance(block, str):
                    parts.append(block)
                elif isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "text":
                    parts.append(block.get("text", ""))
            return "".join(parts)
        return str(content)

    async def run_agent(self) -> Message:
        incoming = self.input_value
        user_text = incoming.text if isinstance(incoming, Message) else str(incoming)
        session_id = getattr(incoming, "session_id", "") or ""

        raw_tools = self.tools if isinstance(self.tools, list) else [self.tools]
        tools = [t for t in raw_tools if t is not None]
        tool_map = {t.name: t for t in tools}

        llm = ChatOpenAI(model=self.model_name, api_key=self.api_key, base_url=self.base_url or None)
        llm_with_tools = llm.bind_tools(tools) if tools else llm

        memory = self.memory
        if memory is not None and not getattr(memory, "session_id", ""):
            memory.session_id = session_id or "default_user"
        history = list(memory.messages) if memory is not None else []

        messages = [SystemMessage(content=self.system_prompt), *history, HumanMessage(content=user_text)]
        trace = []
        final_text = None

        # Smyčka agenta: model -> (nástroj -> model)* -> odpověď
        for _ in range(max(1, int(self.max_iterations or 6))):
            ai = await llm_with_tools.ainvoke(messages)
            messages.append(ai)
            if not getattr(ai, "tool_calls", None):
                final_text = self._to_text(ai.content)
                break
            for call in ai.tool_calls:
                tool = tool_map.get(call["name"])
                try:
                    result = await tool.ainvoke(call["args"]) if tool else f"Neznámý nástroj: {call['name']}"
                except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                    result = f"Chyba nástroje: {e}"
                trace.append(f"{call['name']}({json.dumps(call['args'], ensure_ascii=False)})")
                messages.append(ToolMessage(content=str(result), tool_call_id=call["id"]))

        if final_text is None:
            messages.append(HumanMessage(content="Dosažen limit kroků. Odpověz teď s informacemi, které máš."))
            ai = await llm.ainvoke(messages)
            final_text = self._to_text(ai.content)

        if memory is not None:
            memory.add_messages([HumanMessage(content=user_text), AIMessage(content=final_text)])

        self.status = "Použité nástroje: " + (", ".join(trace) if trace else "žádné")
        return Message(text=final_text, sender="Machine", session_id=session_id)

from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import HandleInput, MessageTextInput, Output
from lfx.schema.message import Message


class ChatOutput(Component):
    display_name = "Chat Output"
    description = "Textová odpověď agenta do Playgroundu."
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatOutput"

    inputs = [
        HandleInput(name="input_value", display_name="Text", input_types=["Message"], required=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="sender_name", display_name="Sender Name", value="AI", advanced=True),
        MessageTextInput(name="session_id", display_name="Session ID", value="", advanced=True),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        value = self.input_value
        text = value.text if isinstance(value, Message) else str(value)
        session_id = self.session_id or (getattr(value, "session_id", "") or "")
        if not session_id:
            try:
                session_id = self.graph.session_id or ""
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                session_id = ""
        message = Message(text=text, sender="Machine", sender_name=self.sender_name, session_id=session_id)
        if session_id:
            try:
                message = await self.send_message(message)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
        self.status = message
        return message
